extracted.intended_audience: MacRumors readers and general tech/Apple news consumers concerned about AI-driven news summaries
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and issues around AI-generated one-sentence notification summaries for news apps (Apple Intelligence feature): how they should be presented, controlled, and made reliable. Focuses on labeling, opt-in controls, accuracy, and impacts on trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarify when notifications are AI summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: A software update ... will further clarify when the text being displayed is summarization provided by Apple Intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make it explicit in the notification UI that the text shown is an AI-generated summary rather than the original headline; this clarification is meant to cut down on confusion caused by inaccurate summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a user reporting mechanism for unexpected summaries
rubrics_metrics.description: We encourage users to report a concern if they view an unexpected notification summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer clear, easy ways for users to flag incorrect or misleading summaries so developers can iteratively improve the feature with real-world feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make notification summaries opt-in and easily disableable
rubrics_metrics.description: Apple Intelligence notification summaries are an opt-in feature and they can be disabled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure users can opt into/opt out of AI-generated summaries and that disabling the feature is straightforward to protect users who prefer original headlines or who distrust automated summaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize factual accuracy; avoid pulling wrong details
rubrics_metrics.description: These short summaries can cause problems when AI pulls the wrong details from news stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design and test summarization systems to avoid fabrications, misattributions, or premature conclusions (examples cited: false claims about Luke Littler winning before a tournament, suggesting Rafael Nadal had come out as gay, Netanyahu arrested, Luigi Mangione suicide). Robust factual-checking or conservative summarization heuristics are recommended.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect consumer trust and the credibility of news organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: BBC News called on Apple to take action because the ongoing Apple Intelligence issue threatens consumer trust in news organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the reputational impact on publishers and news consumers when deploying AI summarization; communicate transparently and mitigate harms to maintain trust between platforms, publishers, and users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consider disabling features if generative AI is not yet reliable
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporters Without Borders urged Apple to disable the Apple Intelligence notification feature after a misleading headline, saying generative AI services are still too immature to produce reliable information for the public.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If automated summaries repeatedly produce harmful or misleading outputs, temporarily disabling the feature or removing it from high-risk contexts is a defensible mitigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design goal: concise one-sentence overviews grouping multiple notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Notification summaries are designed to group multiple notifications from the same app together, providing a one-sentence overview of the content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While brevity and aggregation are desirable, design choices that compress multiple items into a single sentence must be balanced against increased risk of conflating or distorting facts; consider conservative aggregation rules or preserving original headlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate beta status and iterate with user feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Apple Intelligence features are in beta and we are continuously making improvements with the help of user feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Label experimental/ beta features clearly and incorporate ongoing user feedback and monitoring into release cycles to catch and fix problematic summarization behaviors before wider rollout.
